literal: In the first year of Baoda, spring, first month, on dingyou new moon, the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
idiomatic: In the first year of Baoda, on the dingyou new moon of the first spring month the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Earlier, when the Jin rose in arms, nearly half the prefectures and counties were lost.
idiomatic: Earlier, when the Jin rose in arms, nearly half the prefectures and counties were lost.

literal: Tianzuo had four sons: the eldest was Prince of Zhao, mother Consort Zhao;
idiomatic: Tianzuo had four sons: the eldest was Prince of Zhao, whose mother was Consort Zhao;

literal: [1] next Prince of Jin, mother Literary Consort;
idiomatic: [1] next Prince of Jin, whose mother was Literary Consort;

literal: next Prince of Qin and Prince of Xu, all born of the Primary Consort.
idiomatic: next Prince of Qin and Prince of Xu, all born of the Primary Consort.

literal: The people knew the Prince of Jin's worth and deeply looked to him.
idiomatic: The people knew the Prince of Jin's worth and deeply looked to him.

literal: The Primary Consort's elder brother, privy commissioner Xiao Fengxian, feared the Prince of Qin would not be enthroned and secretly plotted against him.
idiomatic: The Primary Consort's elder brother, privy commissioner Xiao Fengxian, feared the Prince of Qin would not be enthroned and secretly plotted against him.

literal: Literary Consort had three sisters: the eldest married Yelü Tayehexi, the second was Literary Consort, the third married Yudu.
idiomatic: Literary Consort had three sisters: the eldest married Yelü Tayehexi, the second was Literary Consort, the third married Yudu.

literal: One day her elder or younger sister all met at the army front; Fengxian prompted men to falsely accuse consort's husband Xiao Yu and Yudu and others of plotting to set up the Prince of Jin; the matter was exposed; Yu, Tayehexi, and others were executed, and Literary Consort was also granted death;
idiomatic: One day her elder or younger sister all met at the army front; Fengxian prompted men to falsely accuse consort's husband Xiao Yu and Yudu and others of plotting to set up the Prince of Jin; when the matter was exposed Yu, Tayehexi, and others were executed, and Literary Consort was also ordered to die;

literal: only the Prince of Jin they did not yet bear to punish.
idiomatic: only the Prince of Jin they did not yet bear to punish.

literal: Yudu was in the army; hearing this he was greatly afraid and at once led more than a thousand horsemen in rebellion into Jin.
idiomatic: Yudu was in the army; hearing this he was greatly afraid and at once led more than a thousand horsemen in rebellion into Jin.

literal: [2] Tianzuo dispatched knower of the Xi royal house affairs Xiao Xiabai, Northern Court chancellor Xiao Degong, grand master of ceremonies Yelü Diligu, Guizhou observation commissioner Xiao Heshangnu, and Four Armies grand master Xiao Gan with their troops in pursuit, reaching Zhulü Mountain prefecture.
idiomatic: [2] Tianzuo dispatched knower of the Xi royal house affairs Xiao Xiabai, Northern Court chancellor Xiao Degong, grand master of ceremonies Yelü Diligu, Guizhou observation commissioner Xiao Heshangnu, and Four Armies grand master Xiao Gan with their troops in pursuit, reaching Zhulü Mountain prefecture.

literal: The generals debated, saying, "The lord trusts Xiao Fengxian's words; Fengxian views us with contempt.
idiomatic: The generals debated, saying, "The lord trusts Xiao Fengxian's words; Fengxian views us with contempt.

literal: Yudu is a clansman of bold talent and would never willingly rank below Fengxian.
idiomatic: Yudu is a clansman of bold talent and would never willingly rank below Fengxian.

literal: If we capture Yudu, another day all our party will be Yudu!
idiomatic: If we capture Yudu, another day all our party will be Yudu!

literal: Better to let him go.
idiomatic: Better to let him go.

literal: " They returned and deceived them, saying, "Pursuit could not overtake him.
idiomatic: " They returned and deceived them, saying, "Pursuit could not overtake him.

literal: " When Fengxian saw Yudu's flight, fearing that later the officers might also rebel, he urged sudden enfeoffments and rewards to bind the army's hearts.
idiomatic: " When Fengxian saw Yudu's flight, fearing that later the officers might also rebel, he urged sudden enfeoffments and rewards to bind the army's hearts.

literal: Xiabai was made Xi king; Degong was made acting Zhongshu Menxia pingzhangshi and concurrently judged Supreme Capital regent affairs; Diligu was made Dragon-Tiger Guard general-in-chief; Heshangnu was made Golden Crow Guard general-in-chief; Gan was made Pacifier of the State grand general.
idiomatic: Xiabai was made Xi king; Degong was made acting Zhongshu Menxia pingzhangshi and concurrently judged Supreme Capital regent affairs; Diligu was made Dragon-Tiger Guard general-in-chief; Heshangnu was made Golden Crow Guard general-in-chief; Gan was made Pacifier of the State grand general.

literal: Second month, the court went to Duck Marsh.
idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Duck Marsh.

literal: Summer, fifth month, arrived at Heli.
idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court arrived at Heli.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted at Coal Mountain.
idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Coal Mountain.

literal: Ninth month, arrived at Nanjing.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the court arrived at Nanjing.

literal: Winter, eleventh month, on guihai day Western Capital regent Prince of Zhao Xini Lie was made tiyin.
idiomatic: On guihai day of the eleventh winter month Western Capital regent Prince of Zhao Xini Lie was made tiyin.

literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on yihai day Jin took Central Capital and advanced to take Ze Prefecture.
idiomatic: In the second year, on yihai day of the first spring month Jin took Central Capital and advanced to take Ze Prefecture.

literal: Tianzuo went out Juyong Pass and arrived at Duck Marsh.
idiomatic: Tianzuo went out Juyong Pass and arrived at Duck Marsh.

literal: Hearing Yudu had led Jin commander Wanyan Wushi to arrive suddenly, Xiao Fengxian said, "Yudu is of the Prince Ban line; he comes intending to set up his nephew the Prince of Jin.
idiomatic: Hearing Yudu had led Jin commander Wanyan Wushi to arrive suddenly, Xiao Fengxian said, "Yudu is of the Prince Ban line; he comes intending to set up his nephew the Prince of Jin.

literal: If for the altars' sake you do not spare one son and clearly state his crime and execute him, without battle Yudu will himself return."
idiomatic: If for the altars' sake you do not spare one son and clearly state his crime and execute him, without battle Yudu will himself return."

literal: Tianzuo thereupon granted the Prince of Jin death; wore plain dress for three days; Yelü Saba and others all were executed.
idiomatic: Tianzuo thereupon granted the Prince of Jin death; wore plain dress for three days; Yelü Saba and others all were executed.

literal: The prince had long held the people's hopes; when the armies heard of his death none did not weep; thereby hearts dissolved.
idiomatic: The prince had long held the people's hopes; when the armies heard of his death none did not weep; thereby hearts dissolved.

literal: Yudu led Jin troops to press the traveling palace; Tianzuo led more than five thousand guard horsemen to Yunzhong and cast the dynastic seal into the Sanggan River.
idiomatic: Yudu led Jin troops to press the traveling palace; Tianzuo led more than five thousand guard horsemen to Yunzhong and cast the dynastic seal into the Sanggan River.

literal: Second month, on gengyin new moon there was an eclipse of the sun; it was total.
idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the second month there was a total eclipse of the sun.

literal: On jiawu day knower of Northern Court great king affairs Yelü Mage and Han traveling-palace chief deployment Xiao Temu were both made commander-in-chief; Taihe Palace envoy Yelü Bude was deputy; they led troops to encamp at Duck Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiawu day knower of Northern Court great king affairs Yelü Mage and Han traveling-palace chief deployment Xiao Temu were both made commander-in-chief; Taihe Palace envoy Yelü Bude was deputy; they led troops to encamp at Duck Marsh.

literal: On jihai day Jin troops defeated Xi king Xiamo at Bei'an Prefecture and thereupon reduced the city.
idiomatic: On jihai day Jin troops defeated Xi king Xiamo at Bei'an Prefecture and thereupon reduced the city.

literal: Third month, on xinyou day Tianzuo heard Jin troops would come out west of the passes and thereupon hastened to White Water Marsh.
idiomatic: On xinyou day of the third month Tianzuo heard Jin troops would come out west of the passes and thereupon hastened to White Water Marsh.

literal: On yichou day herd-marshal Moluwo surrendered to Jin.
idiomatic: On yichou day herd-marshal Moluwo surrendered to Jin.

literal: On bingyin day the court arrived at Nügudi Granary.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the court arrived at Nügudi Granary.

literal: Hearing Jin troops were near and plans nowhere to turn, he rode light horse into Jia Mountain and only then realized Fengxian's disloyalty.
idiomatic: Hearing Jin troops were near and plans nowhere to turn, he rode light horse into Jia Mountain and only then realized Fengxian's disloyalty.

literal: In anger he said, "You father and son brought me to this pass; now if I wish to execute you, what good would it do for affairs!
idiomatic: In anger he said, "You father and son brought me to this pass; now if I wish to execute you, what good would it do for affairs!

literal: I fear the army's hearts will resent it; you crowd avoid the enemy for safety; disaster will surely reach me—you shall not follow on the march."
idiomatic: I fear the army's hearts will resent it; you crowd avoid the enemy for safety; disaster will surely reach me—you shall not follow on the march."

literal: Fengxian dismounted, wept, and bowed before departing.
idiomatic: Fengxian dismounted, wept, and bowed before departing.

literal: After traveling not several li, attendants seized father and son and bound them to send to Jin troops.
idiomatic: After traveling not several li, attendants seized father and son and bound them to send to Jin troops.

literal: The Jin executed his eldest son Ang and sent Fengxian and his second son Yu in fetters to the Jin lord.
idiomatic: The Jin executed his eldest son Ang and sent Fengxian and his second son Yu in fetters to the Jin lord.

literal: On the road they met Liao troops, who seized them and returned to the state; thereupon both were granted death.
idiomatic: On the road they met Liao troops, who seized them and returned to the state; thereupon both were granted death.

literal: Privy commissioner Xiao Delidi was driven off.
idiomatic: Privy commissioner Xiao Delidi was driven off.

literal: Tabuye was summoned to oversee the inner guard.
idiomatic: Tabuye was summoned to oversee the inner guard.

literal: On dingmao day Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Sengxiaonu was made knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs; associate knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs Xiao Chala was made left yilibi.
idiomatic: On dingmao day Northern Court associate privy commissioner Xiao Sengxiaonu was made knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs; associate knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs Xiao Chala was made left yilibi.

literal: On wuchen day associate knower of palace-front inspection affairs Yelü Gaoba led guards in surrender to Jin.
idiomatic: On wuchen day associate knower of palace-front inspection affairs Yelü Gaoba led guards in surrender to Jin.

literal: On jisi day scouts Xiao Heshang and seal-bearer gentleman Yelü Shisi were captured by Jin troops.
idiomatic: On jisi day scouts Xiao Heshang and seal-bearer gentleman Yelü Shisi were captured by Jin troops.

literal: On guiyou day because many of the various offices' artisans and craftsmen had fled, all who followed in attendance without limit of clerk or commoner were given office.
idiomatic: On guiyou day because many of the various offices' artisans and craftsmen had fled, all who followed in attendance without limit of clerk or commoner were given office.

literal: Earlier an edict had left chancellors Zhang Lin and Li Chuwenn with King of Qin-Jin Chun to guard Yan.
idiomatic: Earlier an edict had left chancellors Zhang Lin and Li Chuwenn with King of Qin-Jin Chun to guard Yan.

literal: Chuwenn heard Tianzuo had entered Jia Mountain; for several days orders did not pass through; he with his younger brother Chuneng and son, outwardly borrowing the Resentment Army, inwardly joining commander-in-chief Xiao Gan, plotted to set up Chun.
idiomatic: Chuwenn heard Tianzuo had entered Jia Mountain; for several days orders did not pass through; he with his younger brother Chuneng and son, outwardly borrowing the Resentment Army, inwardly joining commander-in-chief Xiao Gan, plotted to set up Chun.

literal: Thereupon with the great ministers Yelü Dashi, Zuo Qigong, Yu Zhongwen, Cao Yongyi, Kang Gongbi, they gathered Khitan and Han hundred officials, all armies, and elders numbering tens of thousands and went to Chun's residence.
idiomatic: Thereupon with the great ministers Yelü Dashi, Zuo Qigong, Yu Zhongwen, Cao Yongyi, and Kang Gongbi they gathered Khitan and Han hundred officials, all armies, and elders numbering tens of thousands and went to Chun's residence.

literal: Chuwenn invited Zhang Lin and informed him of the matter.
idiomatic: Chuwenn invited Zhang Lin and informed him of the matter.

literal: Lin said, "Regency would suffice."
idiomatic: Lin said, "Regency would suffice."

literal: Chuwenn said, "Heaven's intent and the people's hearts are already settled; please establish the succession."
idiomatic: Chuwenn said, "Heaven's intent and the people's hearts are already settled; please establish the succession."

literal: Chuwenn and others asked Chun to accept the rites; as Chun was coming out, Li held the ochre robe over him and ordered the hundred officials to bow and shout "Long live!"
idiomatic: Chuwenn and others asked Chun to accept the rites; as Chun was coming out, Li held the ochre robe over him and ordered the hundred officials to bow and shout "Long live!"

literal: Chun was startled and repeatedly declined but could not refuse and followed.
idiomatic: Chun was startled and repeatedly declined but could not refuse and followed.

literal: Chuwenn was made Defender Grand Mentor; Zuo Qigong Defender of the State; Cao Yongyi was made knower of privy council affairs; Yu Zhongwen third-rank knower of government affairs; Zhang Lin Defender of the State grand mentor; Li Chuneng direct privy council; Li as junior palace supervisor and director of Hanlin medical officers; Li Shuang, Chen Mi, and more than ten others who had shared in the great plan were all granted advanced-scholar standing and given office in differing degrees.
idiomatic: Chuwenn was made Defender Grand Mentor; Zuo Qigong Defender of the State; Cao Yongyi was made knower of privy council affairs; Yu Zhongwen third-rank knower of government affairs; Zhang Lin Defender of the State grand mentor; Li Chuneng direct privy council; Li as junior palace supervisor and director of Hanlin medical officers; Li Shuang, Chen Mi, and more than ten others who had shared in the great plan were all granted advanced-scholar standing and given office in differing degrees.

literal: Xiao Gan was made Northern privy commissioner; consort's husband commandant Xiao Dan was made knower of privy council affairs.
idiomatic: Xiao Gan was made Northern privy commissioner; consort's husband commandant Xiao Dan was made knower of privy council affairs.

literal: The Resentment Army was changed to Ever-Victorious Army.
idiomatic: The Resentment Army was changed to Ever-Victorious Army.

literal: Thereupon a general amnesty was proclaimed; he styled himself Emperor Heaven-Bestowed, changed the era to Jianfu, and demoted Tianzuo to Prince of Xiangyin.
idiomatic: Thereupon a general amnesty was proclaimed; he styled himself Emperor Heaven-Bestowed, changed the era to Jianfu, and demoted Tianzuo to Prince of Xiangyin.

literal: Thereupon he held Yan, Yun, Ping, and the six circuits of Supreme Capital and Liaoxi.
idiomatic: Thereupon he held Yan, Yun, Ping, and the six circuits of Supreme Capital and Liaoxi.

literal: What Tianzuo still held was only desert north of the sands, the Southwest and Northwest routes' two pacification headquarters, and the various tribal departments.
idiomatic: What Tianzuo still held was only desert north of the sands, the Southwest and Northwest routes' two pacification headquarters, and the various tribal departments.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Fotding surrendered to Jin; Yunnei, Ningbian, Dongsheng, and other prefectures all surrendered.
idiomatic: On xinmao day of the fourth summer month Southwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Fotding surrendered to Jin; Yunnei, Ningbian, Dongsheng, and other prefectures all surrendered.

literal: Ashu was captured by Jin troops.
idiomatic: Ashu was captured by Jin troops.

literal: Jin had already taken Western Capital; southern tribal departments of the desert all surrendered.
idiomatic: Jin had already taken Western Capital; southern tribal departments of the desert all surrendered.

literal: Tianzuo thereupon fled to Esalie.
idiomatic: Tianzuo thereupon fled to Esalie.

literal: At that time the northern Moheshi presented horses, camels, and food sheep.
idiomatic: At that time the northern Moheshi presented horses, camels, and food sheep.

literal: Fifth month, on jiaxu day commander-in-chief Mage gathered the scattered and met at Wuli Jin.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the fifth month commander-in-chief Mage gathered the scattered and met at Wuli Jin.

literal: On bingzi day Mage was made knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs and also commander-in-chief.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Mage was made knower of Northern Court privy commissioner affairs and also commander-in-chief.

literal: Sixth month, Chun lay ill; hearing Tianzuo had issued proclamations to Tiande, Yunnei, Shuo, Wu, Ying, Yu, and other prefectures, gathering tribal elite troops of fifty thousand horsemen, planning in the eighth month to enter Yan;
idiomatic: In the sixth month Chun lay ill; hearing Tianzuo had issued proclamations to Tiande, Yunnei, Shuo, Wu, Ying, Yu, and other prefectures, gathering tribal elite troops of fifty thousand horsemen, planning in the eighth month to enter Yan;

literal: he also sent men to inquire after his health and demand fur coats and tea medicine.
idiomatic: he also sent men to inquire after his health and demand fur coats and tea medicine.

literal: Chun was greatly alarmed and ordered Southern and Northern Court great ministers to debate.
idiomatic: Chun was greatly alarmed and ordered Southern and Northern Court great ministers to debate.

literal: But Li Chuwenn, Xiao Gan, and others had a plan to welcome Qin and resist Xiang; they gathered Khitan and Han hundred officials to debate.
idiomatic: But Li Chuwenn, Xiao Gan, and others had a plan to welcome Qin and resist Xiang; they gathered Khitan and Han hundred officials to debate.

literal: Those who followed their plan stood east;
idiomatic: Those who followed their plan stood east;

literal: only Southern Route field camp chief deployment Yelü Ning stood west.
idiomatic: only Southern Route field camp chief deployment Yelü Ning stood west.

literal: Chuwenn and others asked the reason; Ning said, "If Tianzuo can truly lead all the tribal armies in great force to seize Yan, then Heaven's mandate is not exhausted—how could we resist?
idiomatic: Chuwenn and others asked the reason; Ning said, "If Tianzuo can truly lead all the tribal armies in great force to seize Yan, then Heaven's mandate is not exhausted—how could we resist?

literal: Otherwise, Qin and Xiang are father and son; to resist one is to resist both.
idiomatic: Otherwise, Qin and Xiang are father and son; to resist one is to resist both.

literal: Since ancient times who has ever welcomed the son while rejecting the father?"
idiomatic: Since ancient times who has ever welcomed the son while rejecting the father?"

literal: Chuwenn and others looked at each other and smiled; they thought Ning was stirring army hearts and wished to kill him.
idiomatic: Chuwenn and others looked at each other and smiled; they thought Ning was stirring army hearts and wished to kill him.

literal: Chun leaned on his pillow and sighed long, saying, "He is a loyal minister—how could he be killed?
idiomatic: Chun leaned on his pillow and sighed long, saying, "He is a loyal minister—how could he be killed?

literal: If Tianzuo truly comes, I have death only—what face could I have to meet him!"
idiomatic: If Tianzuo truly comes, I have death only—what face could I have to meet him!"

literal: Before long Chun died; the masses thereupon debated setting his wife Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager to preside over state and army affairs.
idiomatic: Before long Chun died; the masses thereupon debated setting his wife Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager to preside over state and army affairs.

literal: Following his testamentary command, they welcomed Tianzuo's second son Prince of Qin Ding as emperor.
idiomatic: Following his testamentary command, they welcomed Tianzuo's second son Prince of Qin Ding as emperor.

literal: The Empress Dowager thereupon assumed regency and changed the era to Dexing.
idiomatic: The Empress Dowager thereupon assumed regency and changed the era to Dexing.

literal: The Chuwenn father and son feared disaster; south they connected with Tong Guan, wishing to seize Empress Dowager Xiao and offer the land to Song; north they connected with Jin, wishing to be inner responders, outwardly presenting the great merit of aiding enthronement.
idiomatic: The Chuwenn father and son feared disaster; south they connected with Tong Guan, wishing to seize Empress Dowager Xiao and offer the land to Song; north they connected with Jin, wishing to be inner responders, outwardly presenting the great merit of aiding enthronement.

literal: Empress Dowager Xiao cursed, saying, "Those who ruined King of Qin-Jin Chun are all you father and son!
idiomatic: Empress Dowager Xiao cursed, saying, "Those who ruined King of Qin-Jin Chun are all you father and son!

literal: She enumerated their faults by the tens and granted death; quartered the son and dismembered him;
idiomatic: She enumerated their faults by the tens and granted death; quartered the son and dismembered him;

literal: registered their household property and obtained seventy thousand strings of cash; [3] gold, jade, and precious vessels in like measure—what a chancellor had taken in several months.
idiomatic: registered their household property and obtained seventy thousand strings of cash; [3] gold, jade, and precious vessels in like measure—what a chancellor had taken in several months.

literal: Moheshi came with troops to aid but was defeated by Jin at Honghui Water; his son Tuogu and dependent A'diyin were captured.
idiomatic: Moheshi came with troops to aid but was defeated by Jin at Honghui Water; his son Tuogu and dependent A'diyin were captured.

literal: Xia State's relief troops arrived and were also defeated by Jin.
idiomatic: Xia State's relief troops arrived and were also defeated by Jin.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingsi new moon the Dilie tribe Pishi rebelled; Wugu Route military commissioner Yelü Tanggu suppressed them and was advanced to heir-apparent grand mentor.
idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the seventh autumn month the Dilie tribe Pishi rebelled; Wugu Route military commissioner Yelü Tanggu suppressed them and was advanced to heir-apparent grand mentor.

literal: On yichou day Supreme Capital Mao Bashi led two thousand households in surrender to Jin.
idiomatic: On yichou day Supreme Capital Mao Bashi led two thousand households in surrender to Jin.

literal: [4] On xinwei day Xia State dispatched Cao Jia to inquire after health.
idiomatic: [4] On xinwei day Xia State dispatched Cao Jia to inquire after health.

literal: Eighth month, on wuxu day Tianzuo personally encountered Jin troops; they fought at Stone Carriage Post; [5] were defeated; commander-in-chief Xiao Temu and his Sagun were captured.
idiomatic: On wuxu day of the eighth month Tianzuo personally encountered Jin troops; they fought at Stone Carriage Post; [5] were defeated; commander-in-chief Xiao Temu and his Sagun were captured.

literal: On xinchou day the army met at Huan Da New Zhala; Jin troops pressed urgently; they abandoned baggage train to flee.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the army met at Huan Da New Zhala; Jin troops pressed urgently; they abandoned baggage train to flee.

literal: Ninth month, the Dilie tribe rebelled; commander-in-chief Mage overcame them.
idiomatic: In the ninth month the Dilie tribe rebelled; commander-in-chief Mage overcame them.

literal: Winter, tenth month, Jin troops attacked Yu Prefecture and it surrendered.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Jin troops attacked Yu Prefecture and it surrendered.

literal: Eleventh month, on yichou day hearing Jin troops had reached Fengsheng Prefecture, Tianzuo thereupon led guard troops to encamp at Luokun Sui.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the eleventh month, hearing Jin troops had reached Fengsheng Prefecture, Tianzuo thereupon led guard troops to encamp at Luokun Sui.
